description: This file contains helper functions for parsing CPU affinity masks, including parsing individual CPU indices, CPU ranges, and applying these to a bitmask, with external dependencies on OS scheduling and expected value handling.

classes.name: interval<unsigned, true>
classes.description: Represents a range of CPU cores with start and stop positions.

methods.name: parse_int
methods.description: Parses a string into an integer with error handling.

methods.name: is_valid_cpu_index
methods.description: Validates if a CPU index is within available CPU IDs.

methods.name: parse_one_cpu
methods.description: Parses a string as a CPU index and validates it.

methods.name: parse_cpu_range
methods.description: Parses a string as a range of CPU indices.
